subject: SIG Request — access-control artifacts, SCIM mapping & least-privilege clarifications
messages:
From: Niamh O'Connor <security@nimbus.example>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@morganco.com
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up — SCIM role mapping + MFA attestation

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the initial SIG return. Morgan's audit team flagged a couple of open items we need clarity on before we close the access-controls section:

• SCIM provisioning: can you provide a sample mapping (attributes -> Redwood role) and confirm whether we support attribute-based role assignment (ABAC) or only explicit group->role mapping? We need a CSV or spreadsheet we can ingest.
• SSO/SAML: please attach the IdP metadata or a metadata endpoint. Also confirm assertion consumer URL and whether we enforce signed SAML requests.
• RBAC & least-privilege: we saw references to role templates in your answers — could you share the current role inventory (roles, privileges, who can create roles)? An exported snapshot (xlsx) is fine.
• MFA attestation: we need a short statement (signed or on company letterhead) confirming MFA is enforced for all interactive user accounts and for all accounts with admin privileges. A PDF or signed text file will do.

Thanks — target close date for our side is 2028-03-20. If you can get the artifacts by EOD tomorrow it will keep us on timeline.

Best,
Niamh
Head of Security Operations
Nimbus Corp

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow-up — SCIM role mapping + MFA attestation

Rishi / Vanessa — attaching the SCIM mapping snapshot I pulled. Notes:

• File: scim_mapping_snapshot.csv (attached) — includes header/attribute mapping for 6 roles we provision automatically (viewer, analyst, engineer, infra_operator, admin, support). The CSV shows incoming SCIM attributes: email, department, title, manager, groups. Current implementation uses group membership -> role mapping only (no ABAC). We do have an internal RFC for attribute-driven rules but it's not in prod.
• Deprovisioning: SCIM user delete triggers a soft-deactivate event; we keep a deprovision audit entry for 90 days before final purge. I'll include the event list in the CSV comments column.

I put the full export in the evidence Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-nimbus-evidence (read-only link).

Marissa
Solutions Engineer, GTM Security

Hi Niamh — attaching the requested artifacts and clarifications below. See short summary first, full files attached to this message (stubs listed).

Summary:
• SCIM provisioning: we use group-based mapping only; we do not support ABAC in production today. Attached: scim_mapping_snapshot.csv (sample mappings + deprovision event notes).
• SSO/SAML: production metadata attached (sso_saml_metadata.xml). We require signed assertions and validate signature on the IdP side; we also support signed SAML requests for IdPs that enforce it. Assertion consumer URL: https://redwood.example/saml/acs.
• RBAC: attached rbac_role_inventory.xlsx — includes role names, privilege buckets, default role assignments, and which teams have role-creater permissions (Platform Admins + Security Ops). Role creation is gated behind a ticket + peer review process.
• MFA attestation: see MFA draft (mfa_attestation_request.txt) attached — short statement we request legal to sign and return as PDF.

Attachments (stubs): sso_saml_metadata.xml (xml), scim_mapping_snapshot.csv (csv), rbac_role_inventory.xlsx (xlsx), mfa_attestation_request.txt (txt). Full artifacts available in shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-nimbus-evidence

Let us know if you need screenshots of the Admin Console role edit screen or an export in a different format.

Best,
